description: This file contains utility functions and constants used within the FastAPI framework, including helpers for response models, route ID generation, and type handling.

methods.name: bool is_body_allowed_for_status_code(status_code: Union[int, str, None])
methods.description: Checks whether a response body is allowed for the given HTTP status code.

methods.name: set[str] get_path_param_names(path: str)
methods.description: Extracts path parameter names from a URL path string.

methods.name: ModelField create_model_field( name: str, type_: Any, class_validators: Optional[dict[str, Validator]] = None, default: Optional[Any] = Undefined, required: Union[bool, UndefinedType] = Undefined, model_config: Union[type[BaseConfig], None] = None, field_info: Optional[FieldInfo] = None, alias: Optional[str] = None, mode: Literal["validation", "serialization"] = "validation", version: Literal["1", "auto"] = "auto", )
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic model field with specified attributes.

methods.name: ModelField create_cloned_field( field: ModelField, *, cloned_types: Optional[MutableMapping[type[BaseModel], type[BaseModel]]] = None, )
methods.description: Returns a clone of a given ModelField, with possible type cloning (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: str generate_operation_id_for_path( *, name: str, path: str, method: str )
methods.description: Generates a unique operation ID based on name, path, and method (deprecated).

methods.name: str generate_unique_id(route: "APIRoute")
methods.description: Generates a unique route ID based on route properties.

methods.name: None deep_dict_update(main_dict: dict[Any, Any], update_dict: dict[Any, Any])
methods.description: Recursively updates a dictionary with another dictionary's data.

methods.name: Union[DefaultPlaceholder,DefaultType] get_value_or_default( first_item: Union[DefaultPlaceholder, DefaultType], *extra_items: Union[DefaultPlaceholder, DefaultType], )
methods.description: Returns the first item that is not a DefaultPlaceholder, falling back to the first placeholder if all are placeholders.
